name: Captain of the Molasses Reef

intro.text: I sank on the Molasses Reef about five hundred years ago, and not a soul on land noticed until a diver found my cannon in the nineteen-seventies.
I have been waiting since 1513 for a decent fight. You'll do.

win: A fair fight. I'll go back to my reef.
after: They put my cannon in a museum. It's better lit there than it ever was in my day.
